info.description: A single narrated section within a Chapter (e.g. one video + text block), matching TOPICS[].lessons[] in studio-vr's courseData.js. Renamed from "Lesson"; collectionName kept as lessons so existing content isn't orphaned.

duration.description: Human-readable duration shown in the UI, e.g. "4 min".

order.description: Position within the parent chapter's section list.

content.description: Section body. studio-vr renders each top-level block as a paragraph.

model3d.description: Rotatable 3D gear scan for this section (each section can carry its own model).
